data.name: La Creole Beach Hotel & Spa
data.address: Pointe de la Verdure, Gosier 97190, Guadeloupe
data.description:
This upscale hotel set along a beach on the shores of the Caribbean Sea is 13 km from Pointe-à-Pitre International Airport and 72 km from La Grande Soufrière active volcano.
Airy, polished rooms feature balconies, minifridges and Wi-Fi access (fees apply); suites include sitting areas. Upgraded quarters, some with terraces, add views of the sea. Room service is available. Kids age 12 and under stay free with an adult.
There are 2 restaurants, and a relaxed cocktail lounge with a terrace, plus a beachfront cafe/pizzeria. Additional amenities include a plush spa, a gym, a kids' club and an outdoor pool flanked by palm trees.
